verdict.rationale: Controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question for a CRM SaaS like Salesmate, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only covers CRM features, AI agents, pricing and APIs, with nothing on retention policies, deletion controls or data purging. The mention of REST APIs and autonomous record updates is a developer building block or adjacent feature, not a documented retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
